facts.text: Alverno College does not give letter grades, evaluating undergraduate progress through faculty narrative assessments tied to its signature 8 Abilities framework.

sources.title: 8 Abilities | Alverno College
sources.quote: Why doesn't Alverno give grades? Rather than use simple letter grades, we believe in pushing students to reach their highest personal potential. A standard letter grade tells you where you stand today; an Alverno assessment tells you that plus how to take the next step to achieve greater understanding and application of knowledge.

sources.title: 8 Abilities | Alverno College
sources.quote: Woven into every course at Alverno, the 8 Abilities empower our students to become agents of change and principled leaders who meaningfully engage with their communities.
